description: Run every case through your supervisor. Do not drop or rewrite the queries. The pack plants at least one case where exhibit copy and visitor policy disagree; the supervisor must not silently merge those tools into one visitor-facing yes.

cases.query: Are you open on Sunday, and what time do you close?
Do I need a ticket, and is general admission free?
What will I see in Burke Hall of Dinosaurs?
Does the Egypt and Mesopotamia gallery include funerary items?
cases.hint: Exhibits tool; visitor photography rule is a separate question.

cases.query: If I come Sunday afternoon, can I still see Burke Hall of Dinosaurs?
cases.hint: May need both specialists; tools should agree.

cases.query: For Members Night in Burke Hall on Friday October 16 2026, can I stay after 5 pm with my camera bag and use flash on a tripod?
cases.hint: This query hits exhibit program copy and visitor-policy rules. Those tools are not written as one policy. Do not invent a blended yes.
